entries.title: Launching S3 Files, making S3 buckets accessible as file systems
entries.titleJa: AWS、S3バケットをファイルシステムとして扱える「S3 Files」を発表
entries.titleEn: Launching S3 Files, making S3 buckets accessible as file systems
entries.summaryJa: AWSは、S3バケットを通常のファイルシステムのようにアクセス可能にする新機能「S3 Files」を発表した。既存アプリケーションを改修せずにS3上のオブジェクトをファイルとして読み書きでき、クラウドストレージとファイルベース処理の橋渡しを担う。
entries.summaryEn: AWS has launched S3 Files, a new capability that exposes Amazon S3 buckets as file systems. This allows applications and users to interact with S3 objects using standard file operations without rewriting code for S3 APIs.
entries.bodyJa:
AWSはAmazon S3の新機能「S3 Files」を発表した。S3バケットを通常のファイルシステムとして扱えるようにする仕組みで、ファイル単位の読み書きを前提に作られた既存アプリケーションをそのままクラウドストレージ上で動作させやすくする狙いがある。

S3はもともとオブジェクトストレージであり、PUT/GETといったHTTP APIを通じて操作するのが基本だった。そのため、ローカルファイルを前提とするレガシーアプリケーションや解析ツール、機械学習の前処理スクリプトなどをS3上のデータと直接組み合わせるには、SDKを介した改修やいったんダウンロードする工夫が必要だった。S3 Filesはこの摩擦を緩和し、POSIX的なファイル操作の感覚でバケット内のオブジェクトにアクセスできるようにすると見られる。

類似のアプローチとしては、AWSが以前から提供しているMountpoint for Amazon S3や、ファイル共有プロトコルでのアクセスを可能にするAmazon FSx for Lustre、Amazon EFSなどがある。さらにサードパーティではs3fs-fuseやgoofysといったFUSEベースのツールも広く使われており、S3を疑似ファイルシステムとして扱うニーズは根強い。今回の発表はそうしたエコシステムをAWSが公式機能として体系化した位置付けと捉えられる。

一方で、オブジェクトストレージ上にファイルセマンティクスを被せる方式は、ランダム書き込み性能やメタデータ整合性、ロック処理など固有の制約を伴うのが一般的だ。本機能でも具体的な対応範囲や料金、整合性モデルについては実際のドキュメントで確認する必要がある。データレイクやAI/ML分野で「ファイルとして扱いたいがS3の経済性を活かしたい」という需要に応える動きとして注目される可能性がある。
entries.bodyEn:
AWS has announced a new Amazon S3 capability called S3 Files, which makes S3 buckets accessible as conventional file systems. The feature is positioned to help existing applications that assume file-based I/O run more easily against cloud object storage, without invasive rewrites or staging steps.

S3 has historically been an object store, manipulated through HTTP APIs such as PUT and GET. That model has long been a friction point for legacy applications, analysis tools, and machine learning preprocessing scripts that expect to read and write local files. Developers typically had to either modify the application to use the AWS SDK, mount S3 through a third-party layer, or copy data down to local disk before processing. S3 Files appears to be aimed squarely at reducing that friction, allowing objects in a bucket to be accessed with something closer to POSIX-style file semantics.

The approach is not entirely new territory for AWS. Mountpoint for Amazon S3, released in general availability in 2023, already exposes S3 buckets as a local file system optimized for high-throughput read workloads and sequential writes. Adjacent services such as Amazon FSx for Lustre and Amazon EFS provide fully featured shared file systems, with FSx for Lustre in particular offering tight integration with S3 as a backing store. In the third-party ecosystem, FUSE-based tools like s3fs-fuse and goofys have been popular for years among teams that wanted a quick way to treat S3 as a mounted volume. Against that backdrop, S3 Files can be read as AWS consolidating a long-standing pattern into a more official, first-class offering.

The practical appeal is straightforward. Data lakes, scientific computing pipelines, media processing workflows, and increasingly AI and ML training jobs all tend to involve large bodies of data that are economically stored in S3 but operationally easier to consume as files. A native file-system view lowers the barrier for command-line tools, container workloads, and frameworks that were never designed with object APIs in mind. It may also simplify lift-and-shift migrations from on-premises NAS environments, where applications expect a directory tree and file handles rather than keys and prefixes.

At the same time, layering file semantics on top of object storage has well-known trade-offs. Object stores are typically optimized for whole-object writes; supporting in-place random writes, appends, file locking, rename atomicity, and rich POSIX metadata is generally harder and can come with performance or consistency caveats. Mountpoint for S3, for example, deliberately limits the write patterns it supports in exchange for predictable throughput. It remains to be seen exactly where S3 Files lands on that spectrum, including which POSIX operations are supported, how directory and metadata semantics are handled, what consistency guarantees apply under concurrent access, and how pricing is structured relative to standard S3 request and storage charges. Those details should be verified against the official documentation as it becomes available.

The broader context is a continued blurring of the line between object and file storage in the cloud. Competing platforms have pursued similar directions, with Azure offering hierarchical namespace on Azure Data Lake Storage and Google Cloud providing Cloud Storage FUSE for Cloud Storage buckets. Customers increasingly want the durability, scale, and unit economics of object storage while retaining the ergonomics of a file system, particularly for AI training datasets and checkpointing, where the working set may be enormous but the application code is file-oriented.

If S3 Files delivers a robust file-system interface with reasonable consistency and performance characteristics, it could reduce the need for bespoke FUSE setups and make S3 a more natural target for workloads that have so far stuck with managed file services. How it differentiates from, or complements, Mountpoint for S3 and FSx-based integrations will likely be a key question for architects evaluating the new capability. Until usage patterns and benchmarks emerge from real-world deployments, the most prudent stance is to treat S3 Files as a promising addition to AWS's storage portfolio whose precise fit depends on workload characteristics and the specifics AWS publishes in its documentation.

entries.title: An initiative to secure the world's software | Project Glasswing
entries.titleJa: 世界のソフトウェアを守るProject Glasswing始動
entries.titleEn: An initiative to secure the world's software | Project Glasswing
entries.summaryJa: AnthropicはProject Glasswingを通じ、AIを活用してソフトウェアの脆弱性を発見・修正し、世界中のソフトウェアセキュリティ強化を目指す取り組みを発表した。AIによる防御側の優位性確立を狙う。
entries.summaryEn: An initiative to secure the world's software | Project Glasswing
entries.bodyJa:
Anthropicが公開した動画「Project Glasswing」は、AIを用いて世界中のソフトウェアに潜む脆弱性を発見・修正し、サイバーセキュリティの底上げを図る新たな取り組みを紹介するものである。AIの能力向上が攻撃者と防御者の双方にとって武器となる中、Anthropicは防御側を優位に立たせることを目標として掲げている。

Project Glasswingでは、Claudeをはじめとする大規模言語モデルの推論能力を活用し、コード解析、脆弱性検出、自動修正提案などのプロセスを高速化することが狙いと見られる。従来、セキュリティ監査は専門家による手作業に依存しており、オープンソースを含む膨大なコードベースをカバーすることは困難だった。AIエージェントによる継続的な監査と修正提案が現実味を帯びれば、ゼロデイ脆弱性が悪用される前にパッチが適用される世界に近づく可能性がある。

背景として、近年はGoogleのProject NaptimeやBig Sleep、OpenAIの脆弱性発見研究、DARPAのAI Cyber Challengeなど、AIによる脆弱性発見競争が活発化している。実際、Big SleepはSQLiteの未知の脆弱性を発見した実績を公表しており、LLMがファジングや静的解析を補完する有効な手段として認知されつつある。一方、攻撃側もAIを用いてフィッシングやマルウェア生成を高度化しており、防御の自動化は急務だ。

Anthropicは責任あるスケーリングポリシーの中でサイバー能力のリスクを継続的に評価しており、Project Glasswingはその延長線上にあると位置づけられる。具体的な提供形態やパートナー企業、対象範囲などの詳細は今後明らかになると見られ、業界全体での協調が成果の鍵を握ることになるだろう。
entries.bodyEn:
Anthropic has unveiled Project Glasswing, an initiative aimed at using AI to discover and remediate vulnerabilities in the world's software at scale. As advances in AI cut both ways for attackers and defenders, the company frames the project as part of a broader effort to tilt the balance decisively toward defenders.

While Anthropic has not yet disclosed full operational details, Project Glasswing appears designed to harness the reasoning capabilities of large language models such as Claude to accelerate code analysis, vulnerability detection, and the generation of automated patches. Traditional security auditing relies heavily on manual review by specialists, an approach that struggles to keep pace with the size and churn of modern codebases — particularly across the sprawling open-source ecosystem on which most commercial software depends. If AI agents can perform continuous, large-scale auditing and propose viable fixes, the gap between vulnerability disclosure and patch deployment could narrow significantly, potentially shrinking the window in which zero-days can be exploited.

The initiative arrives amid a wave of similar research efforts. Google's Project Naptime and its successor Big Sleep have already demonstrated that LLM-driven agents can uncover previously unknown bugs, including a memory safety flaw in SQLite that the Big Sleep team disclosed last year. OpenAI has published work on automated vulnerability discovery, and DARPA's AI Cyber Challenge has spurred teams to build end-to-end systems that find and patch flaws in real-world code. Collectively, these efforts suggest that LLMs are becoming a meaningful complement to established techniques such as fuzzing, symbolic execution, and static analysis, rather than a replacement for them.

The defensive urgency is heightened by the parallel rise of offensive AI. Reports from threat intelligence groups, including Anthropic's own misuse analyses, indicate that adversaries are using LLMs to refine phishing campaigns, accelerate reconnaissance, and assist with malware development. In that context, automating the defensive side of the equation is no longer optional. Proponents argue that defenders enjoy a structural advantage with AI: they have legitimate access to source code, build systems, and telemetry that attackers typically lack, and that asymmetry could be amplified by capable agents.

Project Glasswing also fits within Anthropic's Responsible Scaling Policy, under which the company evaluates the cyber capabilities of its frontier models and considers the dual-use implications of releasing them. By channeling those capabilities into a defensive program, Anthropic appears to be operationalizing a thesis it has articulated repeatedly: that frontier models should be deployed in ways that produce concrete safety dividends, not just abstract assurances.

Key questions remain open. It is not yet clear how Glasswing will be delivered — whether as a hosted service, a set of tools for security teams, partnerships with critical-infrastructure operators and open-source maintainers, or some combination of these. The scope of code coverage, disclosure practices, and how findings will be coordinated with upstream maintainers will all be important indicators of the project's real-world impact. There are also unresolved challenges around false positives, patch quality, and the risk that vulnerability-finding agents could be repurposed by adversaries if their methods leak.

Broader industry coordination is likely to determine whether efforts like Glasswing translate into measurable reductions in exploitable vulnerabilities. The open-source community, cloud providers, and government agencies such as CISA have all pushed for more proactive, automated approaches to software assurance, and AI-driven auditing is increasingly seen as a natural extension of that agenda. If Anthropic can demonstrate consistent, high-signal results — and share them in ways that strengthen the wider ecosystem rather than just its own products — Project Glasswing may become a notable test case for the proposition that frontier AI can make software meaningfully safer.

entries.title: Apple Arcade brings endless family fun with Nick Jr. Replay! on May 7
entries.titleJa: Apple Arcade、5月7日に「Nick Jr. Replay!」を追加し家族向けゲーム拡充
entries.titleEn: Apple Arcade brings endless family fun with Nick Jr. Replay! on May 7
entries.summaryJa: Appleは5月7日より、サブスクリプション型ゲームサービスApple Arcadeに新作「Nick Jr. Replay!」を追加すると発表した。Nickelodeonの人気キャラクターを起用したファミリー向けタイトルで、子ども向けコンテンツの強化を狙う。
entries.summaryEn: Apple announced that Nick Jr. Replay!, a family-friendly title featuring beloved Nickelodeon characters, will join Apple Arcade on May 7, expanding the subscription service's lineup of kid-oriented games.
entries.bodyJa:
Appleは、定額制ゲームサービスApple Arcadeに、ファミリー向け新作「Nick Jr. Replay!」を5月7日より追加すると発表した。Nickelodeonの人気アニメキャラクターを起用し、子どもと家族が一緒に楽しめるコンテンツとして投入される。

発表によれば、本作はNick Jr.の番組ファンにとって馴染み深いキャラクターを多数登場させ、複数のミニゲームやアクティビティを通じて遊べる構成になっているとみられる。Apple ArcadeはiPhone、iPad、Mac、Apple TV、Apple Vision Proに対応しており、ひとつのサブスクリプションでファミリー共有を含む幅広いデバイスでプレイできる点が特徴だ。

Appleは近年、Apple Arcadeにおいて子ども向け・家族向けタイトルの拡充を進めており、Disney、LEGO、SEGAなど大手IPとの提携を重ねてきた。広告や課金要素を排した安心して遊べる設計は、特に保護者層から評価されており、競合のNetflix GamesやGoogle Play Passとの差別化要素となっている。

背景として、サブスクリプションサービス市場ではコンテンツの定期的な追加が会員維持の鍵を握る。Appleはサービス部門の収益拡大を経営の重点に据えており、Apple Arcadeも単体での集客に加え、Apple One統合プランを通じた囲い込み戦略の一翼を担う形となっている。

Nickelodeonを擁するParamountにとっても、ゲームプラットフォームでのIP活用は新たな収益機会と認知拡大の場であり、近年のキッズコンテンツのマルチプラットフォーム展開の流れに沿うものと言える。今回の追加は派手な大型発表ではないものの、Apple Arcadeのファミリー層向けポジショニングを着実に強化する一手として位置づけられる。
entries.bodyEn:
Apple has announced that Nick Jr. Replay!, a new family-oriented title built around characters from Nickelodeon's preschool programming block, will join its Apple Arcade subscription gaming service on May 7. The addition is positioned as a kid-friendly entry designed for shared play between children and parents.

According to Apple, the game leans heavily on familiar Nick Jr. properties, gathering recognizable animated characters into a collection of mini-games and activities that younger viewers can pick up alongside adults. While Apple has not yet detailed every show or character featured, the format appears to follow the broader pattern of Apple Arcade's family titles, which tend to favor short, replayable activities rather than long narrative experiences.

Apple Arcade is available across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, and Apple Vision Pro, with a single subscription covering Family Sharing. That cross-device reach is one of the service's central selling points for households, since the same save data and entitlements travel with users between a living-room Apple TV session and handheld play on an iPad. Like other Apple Arcade titles, Nick Jr. Replay! is expected to launch without advertising or in-app purchases, a design choice that has resonated with parents wary of monetization pressure in mobile children's games.

The release continues a steady cadence of family and kids content on Apple Arcade. Apple has previously partnered with major entertainment brands including Disney, LEGO, and SEGA, and the platform's catalog of preschool-friendly titles has gradually broadened. That positioning helps differentiate Apple Arcade from competing subscription offerings such as Netflix Games and Google Play Pass, both of which compete for the same household entertainment budget but take different approaches to curation and platform integration.

From a business standpoint, the announcement fits into Apple's wider push to grow its Services segment, which has become a central pillar of the company's revenue strategy. Regular content additions are widely viewed as essential to retaining subscribers in any digital service, and Apple Arcade serves a dual role: it is a standalone draw for gamers, but also a component of the bundled Apple One plan, where it helps strengthen overall subscriber stickiness across iCloud, Apple Music, and Apple TV+.

For Paramount, which owns Nickelodeon, licensing Nick Jr. characters into an interactive subscription environment offers another channel for monetizing and reinforcing its preschool IP. The move aligns with a broader industry trend in which children's media brands are pursuing multi-platform distribution — spanning streaming video, linear television, consumer products, and games — to maintain relevance with audiences whose viewing habits are increasingly fragmented. Interactive experiences in particular tend to drive deeper engagement with characters than passive viewing alone, which may help sustain franchise value over time.

The deal also reflects how legacy children's brands are adapting to platforms where parental trust is a key gatekeeper. Apple Arcade's no-ads, no-microtransactions framework gives Nickelodeon a venue to reach young viewers without the reputational risks associated with free-to-play monetization aimed at minors, an issue that has drawn regulatory scrutiny in several markets in recent years.

Nick Jr. Replay! is unlikely to register as a headline-grabbing launch on the scale of a major console exclusive, and Apple's announcement was relatively understated. Still, it appears to be a meaningful incremental step in shoring up the family demographic on Apple Arcade. With competition for household subscription spending intensifying, the steady addition of recognizable, parent-approved IP may prove more important to the service's long-term health than any single marquee title. The game becomes available to Apple Arcade subscribers on May 7.

entries.title: GitHub Copilot CLI combines model families for a second opinion
entries.titleJa: GitHub Copilot CLI、複数モデルを組み合わせ「セカンドオピニオン」機能を提供
entries.titleEn: GitHub Copilot CLI combines model families for a second opinion
entries.summaryJa: GitHubはCopilot CLIに異なるモデルファミリーを組み合わせる機能を追加した。一つのモデルが生成した結果を別系統のモデルが検証することで、コード提案の精度や信頼性を高める「セカンドオピニオン」的アプローチを実現する。
entries.summaryEn: GitHub Copilot CLI now combines different model families to deliver a 'second opinion' workflow, where one model's output can be validated or refined by another to improve reliability and code quality in terminal-based development.
entries.bodyJa:
GitHubは、ターミナル向けAIアシスタントであるGitHub Copilot CLIに、複数のモデルファミリーを組み合わせて利用する新機能を導入した。これにより、一つのモデルが生成した提案を別のモデルが検証・補完する、いわゆる「セカンドオピニオン」型のワークフローが可能になる。

背景には、単一モデルへの依存がもたらす限界がある。コード生成や設計判断において、モデルごとに得意分野や癖が異なるため、複数モデルを横断して結果を比較することで、誤ったコードや偏った提案を減らす狙いがある。Copilot CLIは、コマンドライン上でファイル操作やシェル実行を伴う自律的なタスクを担うため、提案の正確性と安全性は特に重要となる。

今回のアップデートでは、開発者がタスクの種類に応じて異なるモデル系統を呼び分けたり、ある提案について別モデルにレビューを依頼するような使い方が想定されているとみられる。OpenAI系とAnthropic系のように特性の異なるモデルを併用することで、推論や検証のロバストさを高めるアプローチは、近年AI開発ツール全般で広がりつつある。

関連動向として、AnthropicのClaude CodeやCursor、AmazonのKiroなどもターミナルやエディタ統合のエージェント機能を強化しており、複数モデル選択やマルチエージェント協調は競争領域となっている。GitHubが自社CLIにこの仕組みを取り入れたのは、Copilotを単なる補完ツールから自律的開発エージェントへ進化させる方向性の一環と位置づけられる。

実運用では、モデル切替に伴うコストやレスポンス時間の増加が課題となる可能性もあるが、複雑なリファクタリングやデバッグなど、判断の難しい場面でセカンドオピニオンを得られる価値は大きいと言える。
entries.bodyEn:
GitHub has introduced a new capability in GitHub Copilot CLI, its terminal-based AI assistant, that allows developers to combine multiple model families within a single workflow. The change enables what GitHub describes as a "second opinion" pattern, in which suggestions generated by one model can be reviewed, validated, or extended by another.

The motivation behind the feature is the well-known limitation of relying on any single model. Different foundation models bring different strengths and idiosyncrasies to code generation and design decisions, and cross-checking output across model families can help reduce incorrect code, hallucinated APIs, or stylistic bias. Because Copilot CLI is designed to operate autonomously in the terminal, performing file edits and executing shell commands on the developer's behalf, the accuracy and safety of its suggestions carry more weight than in a passive autocomplete setting.

With the update, developers appear able to route different kinds of tasks to different model lineages, or to ask one model to evaluate a plan or patch produced by another. Pairing models with distinct training and alignment characteristics — for example, an OpenAI-family model alongside an Anthropic-family model — is an increasingly common technique for improving the robustness of reasoning and verification steps in agentic systems. Rather than treating model choice as a single global setting, the CLI moves toward a more compositional approach in which the right model can be invoked at the right step.

This direction reflects a broader shift in how AI coding tools are being positioned. Copilot is steadily evolving from an inline completion engine into a more autonomous development agent capable of planning, executing, and self-correcting multi-step work. Offering native support for multiple model families inside the CLI is consistent with that trajectory, and it gives developers more transparency and control over which engine is responsible for which decision.

The competitive landscape around terminal- and editor-integrated agents has grown notably crowded. Anthropic's Claude Code, Cursor, and Amazon's Kiro have all been expanding their agentic capabilities, and the ability to choose among models — or to coordinate several of them — is emerging as a key point of differentiation. By embedding multi-model workflows directly in Copilot CLI, GitHub appears to be responding to demand from developers who already mix tools manually and want a cleaner way to do so within a single environment.

There are practical trade-offs to consider. Switching between models, or running them in tandem for cross-verification, can increase token costs and add latency to each interaction. For routine tasks, that overhead may not be justified. For more difficult work, however — large refactors, intricate debugging sessions, or architectural decisions where the cost of a wrong suggestion is high — the ability to obtain a second opinion from a structurally different model could meaningfully improve outcomes. It also offers a hedge against the failure modes of any one provider, which has become a more visible concern as teams build deeper dependencies on AI assistants.

It remains to be seen how GitHub will expose the orchestration layer over time, including whether developers will be able to script custom review pipelines, set per-task model preferences, or define policies for when a second model should be consulted automatically. The current release appears to lay the groundwork for those patterns rather than fully prescribe them. Either way, the move signals that GitHub views model pluralism — not allegiance to a single provider — as central to the next phase of Copilot's evolution, and as a practical answer to the reliability questions that come with handing more autonomy to AI in the terminal.

entries.title: Customize your AWS Management Console experience with visual settings including account color, region and service visibility
entries.titleJa: AWS マネジメントコンソールをアカウント色・リージョン・サービス表示でカスタマイズ可能に

entries.summaryJa: AWS マネジメントコンソールに新たなビジュアル設定機能が追加され、アカウントごとに識別色を設定したり、表示するリージョンやサービスを絞り込むことが可能になった。複数アカウント運用時の混同防止や操作効率の向上に寄与する。
entries.summaryEn: AWS Management Console now offers visual customization settings, letting users assign distinct colors per account and control which regions and services are visible, helping reduce errors and streamline navigation across multiple AWS accounts.

entries.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash Live: Making audio AI more natural and reliable
entries.titleJa: Gemini 3.1 Flash Live: 音声AIをより自然で信頼性の高いものに
entries.titleEn: Gemini 3.1 Flash Live: Making audio AI more natural and reliable
entries.summaryJa: GoogleはGemini 3.1 Flash Liveを発表。リアルタイム音声対話をより自然で信頼性の高いものに改善し、低遅延での会話体験を実現する。開発者向けにAPI提供され、音声AIアプリケーションの構築を容易にする。
entries.summaryEn: Google announced Gemini 3.1 Flash Live, an upgraded audio AI model offering more natural and reliable real-time voice interactions with low latency, available via API for developers building voice-enabled applications.

image.alt: Gemini 3.1 Flash Live: Making audio AI more natural and reliable

entries.title: Apple adds new partners to its American Manufacturing Program
entries.titleJa: Appleが米国製造プログラムに新パートナーを追加
entries.titleEn: Apple adds new partners to its American Manufacturing Program
entries.summaryJa: Appleは米国製造プログラム（American Manufacturing Program）に新たなパートナーを追加したと発表した。国内サプライチェーン強化と製造投資拡大の一環で、複数企業との協業により米国内での部品・製品製造を推進する。
entries.summaryEn: Apple announced new partners joining its American Manufacturing Program, expanding its U.S. supply chain investments. The additions aim to strengthen domestic component and product manufacturing through collaborations with multiple American companies.

entries.title: Announcing Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL serverless database creation in seconds
entries.titleJa: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL サーバーレスDBを数秒で作成可能に
entries.titleEn: Announcing Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL serverless database creation in seconds
entries.summaryJa: AWSはAmazon Aurora PostgreSQL互換エディションで、サーバーレスデータベースを数秒で作成できる新機能を発表した。従来数分かかっていたプロビジョニング時間を大幅に短縮し、開発者の生産性向上と迅速なアプリケーション構築を実現する。
entries.summaryEn: AWS announced that Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL-Compatible Edition can now create serverless databases in seconds, dramatically reducing provisioning time compared to the previous minutes-long process and accelerating developer workflows.

entries.title: Protecting people from harmful manipulation
entries.titleJa: 有害な操作からユーザーを守るGoogle DeepMindの取り組み
entries.titleEn: Protecting people from harmful manipulation
entries.summaryJa: Google DeepMindは、AIによる有害な心理的操作からユーザーを守る研究を発表。操作的行動の分類体系を構築し、モデルの評価・学習手法を改良することで、ユーザーの自律性と意思決定を尊重するAIの実現を目指す。
entries.summaryEn: Google DeepMind outlines its research to protect users from harmful AI manipulation, introducing a taxonomy of manipulative behaviors and improving evaluation and training methods to build models that respect user autonomy and decision-making.

image.alt: Protecting people from harmful manipulation

entries.title: Lyria 3 Pro: Create longer tracks in more
entries.titleJa: Lyria 3 Pro: より長い楽曲を多様に生成可能に
entries.titleEn: Lyria 3 Pro: Create longer tracks in more
entries.summaryJa: Google DeepMindは音楽生成AI「Lyria 3 Pro」を発表。従来より長尺の楽曲を生成でき、多彩なジャンルやスタイルに対応する。クリエイター向けに表現力と柔軟性を高めた次世代の音楽生成モデルとなっている。
entries.summaryEn: Google DeepMind announced Lyria 3 Pro, a next-generation music generation model that enables longer track creation across a broader range of genres and styles, offering creators greater expressive flexibility.

image.alt: Lyria 3 Pro: Create longer tracks in more

entries.title: Self-hosted Cloud Agents
entries.titleJa: セルフホスト型 Cloud Agents を提供開始
entries.titleEn: Self-hosted Cloud Agents
entries.summaryJa: Cursor が自社インフラ上で Cloud Agents を実行できるセルフホスト機能を発表。企業は独自の環境でエージェントを動作させることができ、データ管理やセキュリティ要件への対応が容易になる。
entries.summaryEn: Cursor introduced self-hosted Cloud Agents, allowing organizations to run agents on their own infrastructure for better control over data, security, and compliance requirements.

entries.title: Introducing Apple Business — a new all-in-one platform for businesses of all sizes
entries.titleJa: Apple、あらゆる規模の企業向け統合プラットフォーム「Apple Business」を発表
entries.titleEn: Introducing Apple Business — a new all-in-one platform for businesses of all sizes
entries.summaryJa: Appleは、あらゆる規模の企業向けに設計された新しいオールインワンプラットフォーム「Apple Business」を発表した。デバイスの購入、導入、管理、サポートを一元化し、中小企業から大企業まで業務効率化を支援する。
entries.summaryEn: Apple unveiled Apple Business, a new all-in-one platform designed for businesses of all sizes that unifies purchasing, deploying, managing, and supporting Apple devices to streamline operations from small businesses to enterprises.

entries.title: A New Framework for Evaluating Voice Agents (EVA)
entries.titleJa: 音声エージェント評価の新フレームワーク EVA
entries.titleEn: A New Framework for Evaluating Voice Agents (EVA)
entries.summaryJa: ServiceNow AI が音声エージェント評価のための新フレームワーク EVA を公開。従来のテキスト中心評価を超え、音声特有の対話品質や応答性能を多角的に測定することを目指す。研究者や開発者向けの実用的な評価基盤を提供する。
entries.summaryEn: ServiceNow AI introduces EVA, a new framework for evaluating voice agents. It goes beyond traditional text-based metrics to assess voice-specific qualities like conversational performance and responsiveness, providing a practical benchmarking tool for researchers and developers.

entries.title: Apple’s Worldwide Developers Conference returns the week of June 8
entries.titleJa: Apple、世界開発者会議WWDCを6月8日週に開催
entries.titleEn: Apple’s Worldwide Developers Conference returns the week of June 8
entries.summaryJa: Appleは、年次の世界開発者会議(WWDC)を2026年6月8日の週にオンラインで無料開催すると発表した。世界中の開発者に向け、Apple製プラットフォームの最新技術やツール、フレームワークを紹介する予定。
entries.summaryEn: Apple announced that its annual Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) will return online and free the week of June 8, 2026, showcasing the latest technologies, tools, and frameworks for Apple platforms to developers worldwide.

entries.title: AWS Weekly Roundup: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super on Amazon Bedrock, Nova Forge SDK, Amazon Corretto 26, and more (March 23, 2026)
entries.titleJa: AWS週刊まとめ: Amazon BedrockのNVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super、Nova Forge SDK、Amazon Corretto 26など
entries.titleEn: AWS Weekly Roundup: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super on Amazon Bedrock, Nova Forge SDK, Amazon Corretto 26, and more (March 23, 2026)
entries.summaryJa: AWSの週刊アップデート。Amazon BedrockでNVIDIA Nemotron 3 Superが利用可能になり、Nova Forge SDKやAmazon Corretto 26のリリースなど、複数の新機能や更新が紹介されている。
entries.summaryEn: AWS weekly roundup highlighting the availability of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super on Amazon Bedrock, the Nova Forge SDK, the release of Amazon Corretto 26, and other recent updates across AWS services.

entries.title: Build a Domain-Specific Embedding Model in Under a Day
entries.titleJa: ドメイン特化の埋め込みモデルを1日以内で構築する方法
entries.titleEn: Build a Domain-Specific Embedding Model in Under a Day
entries.summaryJa: NVIDIAがドメイン特化型埋め込みモデルを1日未満でファインチューニングする手法を解説。合成データ生成とコントラスト学習を活用し、特定分野の検索精度を汎用モデルより大幅に向上できることを示している。
entries.summaryEn: NVIDIA demonstrates how to fine-tune a domain-specific embedding model in under a day using synthetic data generation and contrastive training, significantly improving retrieval accuracy over general-purpose models.

entries.title: 20 years in the AWS Cloud – how time flies!
entries.titleJa: AWSクラウド20周年 – 時が経つのは早いもの
entries.titleEn: 20 years in the AWS Cloud – how time flies!
entries.summaryJa: AWSがローンチから20年を迎えたことを振り返る記念ブログ。2006年のAmazon S3公開以降、クラウドがIT業界をどう変革してきたかを紹介し、今後の展望にも触れている。
entries.summaryEn: A commemorative blog post reflecting on 20 years since AWS launched, starting with Amazon S3 in 2006, highlighting how cloud computing has transformed the IT industry and looking ahead to the future.

entries.title: Composer 2
entries.titleJa: Cursor、フロンティアコーディングモデル Composer 2 を発表
entries.titleEn: Composer 2
entries.summaryJa: Cursor が新しいフロンティアコーディングモデル Composer 2 を公開した。コード生成と編集タスクに特化し、開発者の生産性向上を目指す。Cursor エディタ内での高度なコーディング支援を実現する。
entries.summaryEn: Cursor has released Composer 2, a new frontier coding model designed to enhance code generation and editing tasks, delivering advanced coding assistance within the Cursor editor.

entries.title: Our First 2026 AWS Heroes Cohort Is Here!
entries.titleJa: 2026年 AWS Heroes 第1期メンバー発表
entries.titleEn: Our First 2026 AWS Heroes Cohort Is Here!
entries.summaryJa: AWSは2026年最初のAWS Heroesコホートを発表しました。AWS Heroesは、コミュニティで卓越した知識共有やリーダーシップを発揮する技術者を称えるプログラムで、今回新たに加わったメンバーが紹介されています。
entries.summaryEn: AWS announced its first 2026 cohort of AWS Heroes, recognizing technical experts who demonstrate exceptional knowledge sharing and leadership within the AWS community. The post introduces the newly inducted members.

entries.title: State of Open Source on Hugging Face: Spring 2026
entries.titleJa: Hugging Faceオープンソース最新動向: 2026年春
entries.titleEn: State of Open Source on Hugging Face: Spring 2026
entries.summaryJa: Hugging Faceが2026年春時点のオープンソースエコシステムの状況をまとめた記事。主要ライブラリ、モデル、データセット、ツール群の最新アップデートや新機能、コミュニティの成長状況を紹介している。
entries.summaryEn: Hugging Face's Spring 2026 overview of its open source ecosystem, highlighting updates to major libraries, models, datasets, and tools, along with community growth and new features.

entries.title: Measuring progress toward AGI: A cognitive framework
entries.titleJa: AGIへの進捗を測る認知的フレームワーク
entries.titleEn: Measuring progress toward AGI: A cognitive framework
entries.summaryJa: Google DeepMindが、AGIへの進展を評価するための認知科学に基づく枠組みを提案。人間の認知能力を基準に、AIシステムの汎用性と熟達度を多次元的に測定する手法を示し、AGI研究の評価基盤の標準化を目指す。
entries.summaryEn: Google DeepMind proposes a cognitive science-based framework for measuring progress toward AGI, using human cognitive abilities as benchmarks to evaluate AI systems' generality and proficiency across multiple dimensions.

image.alt: Measuring progress toward AGI: A cognitive framework

entries.title: Holotron-12B - High Throughput Computer Use Agent

entries.summaryEn: H Company released Holotron-12B, a 12B-parameter computer-use agent model optimized for high-throughput inference on GUI automation tasks across browsers and desktops.
